reviews.review: I Came For The tf2 hat Got A really Good Free Game In return
This is genuinely one of the best free games on steam, decent length campaign with different enemies, objectives, weapons, upgrades. Coop is so much fun with 3 friends.

Alien Swarm is a good one, I play the campaign with friend many times. I always use the flamethrower and he hates when I pick this weapon. He just uses duel pistol all the time and die. He threaten once that he would beat me up if I use the flamethrower again, but I see his bluff. Matio talks big but he is a push over. In real life Matio is very agreeable, to a fault, and nobody respect him. He projects his anger and frustration onto me when we play Alien Swarms, he want to control my selection of weaponry because he believe I am stupid, he tell me that the ammo is not efficient, “Matio” I says “Matio, you die again because you only use duel pistol like Neal from The Matrics (1999)”, He get angry like usual and say he going to throw molotov at me and my roommates, he is full of hot air. “Matio” I says “Matio, Just try using a shotgun or an railgun...”, He screeched at me over microphone and knocked a bunch of bottles off his desk before disconnecting the call. I don't know why Matio Is like this online, I know he means well but does not have an output for his anger and frustration. 

Pro
-Run and gun action
-Furious vengeance against alien
-Many weapons and guns of which Matio refuses to acknowledge
-Dense firefights

Con
-Blood
-Violens
-Not many missions
-Horrible Frights 


7/10 says me, pretty good score I says. 

I wish Matio was easier to talk to, he doesn't listen and doesn't care what others have to say. In real life he care too much about what others think and tries to be friend everybody. I says to Matio “If you keep this up you will never find any more real friends, stop putting on airs” 
he didn't say anything.
